targets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: exactly ONE isolated source-art exterior sprite for DEADWALL — Last Enclosure. Image 1 is the ORIGINAL GAME BUILDINGS ATLAS: use only as painting-style and high-camera reference, never copy its checkerboard. Serious semi-realistic hand-painted abandoned strategy-game architecture; muted gray, olive, dusty earth, aged plaster, old brick and restrained rust, believable human scale. CAMERA: orthographic from 75 degrees above the ground, only 15 degrees away from vertically straight down. Building footprint axes align horizontally and vertically with the image. The roof is deep and dominant, the visible front facade at image bottom is a very narrow foreshortened strip. Correct floor count must survive in those short facade bands. No diamond/isometric rotation, low cinematic perspective or tall dollhouse elevation. Intact roof, no cutaway. Ground-level doors and thresholds touch the ground; the rear exit may be naturally occluded. No rooftop door or staircase. Exactly one centered cohesive building, generous transparent margins, true RGBA alpha, only a short contact shadow. No checkerboard, matte, background color, gradient, halo, terrain tile or display plinth. No text, letters, logo, pictogram, UI, watermark, people, animals, vehicles, fire, smoke, active machinery, detached props or invented annexes. Facade materials and precise roof details are artistic interpretations; the controlling geometry and level count are the actual native plan. This is source art for later calibration, with no asserted reassignment to a Codex card. Petit collectif: one compact apartment block 26 m wide by 22 m deep, exactly THREE total above-ground levels, ground floor plus two upper storeys. Weathered concrete and muted plaster, low broad flat roof with a few discreet vents, repetitive modest domestic windows and one central entrance at ground level. The inherited apartments programme repeats domestic rooms across levels. Roof dominates and the three facade bands remain extremely foreshortened. No fourth floor, exposed interior, basement stair, projecting balconies or apartment campus.
